title: Cover every presentation component with a SMOKE browser spec named after its wagon

facts.note: Component files under a `presentation/` path segment; vendored/generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated) excluded.
Needs htmx_e2e_detector (or an equivalent observer) to report, per component, that no SMOKE browser spec naming its wagon covers it; existence of a wagon-named spec alone is not sufficient.

fires: A new `.tsx` component is added under `<wagon>/presentation/` and no SMOKE browser spec path contains `<wagon>`.
A SMOKE browser spec named after the wagon already exists, but a newly added or previously uncovered component in that wagon is not covered by it.
A `.jsx` component under a `presentation/` segment exists, and the only test touching its wagon is a unit test that mentions a journey URN in a string.
The detector reports a presentation component not covered by a SMOKE browser spec naming its wagon.
doesNotFire: A `.tsx` component lives outside any `presentation/` path segment.

given: A `.tsx`/`.jsx` component under a `presentation/` path segment (wagon = the segment before `presentation`).
when: The component is added or changed, or the detector finds it uncovered.
then: Ensure this component is covered by a SMOKE browser spec whose path names the component's wagon.
prefer: Add a SMOKE spec whose file name contains the wagon, e.g. `e2e/checkout-cart.smoke.e2e.ts`.
Make the spec a real browser spec: a `*.e2e.ts` run by Playwright, or a test file whose header comments carry a journey marker.
avoid: Relying on structural/unit tests as coverage — they stay green while the rendered feature is blank.
Counting a unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string as a browser spec.
Naming a smoke spec without the wagon, so coverage cannot be attributed.
Treating an existing wagon-named spec as covering every component in the wagon without it actually covering this one.
unless: The component is in a vendored or generated tree (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) — never scanned.
The component is outside a `presentation/` segment — out of scope.
why: Structural tests stay green while a rendered feature is blank; only rendering it in a browser proves it appears.
evidence: For every `.tsx`/`.jsx` under a `presentation/` segment, that component is covered by a SMOKE browser spec whose path contains the wagon name.
htmx_e2e_detector reports no uncovered presentation component (strict: any finding fails).
verifier_detail: Wagon = the path segment immediately before `presentation`.

browser_spec = a `*.e2e.ts` file run by Playwright, OR any test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`), so a misnamed one is still judged.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string (not a header comment marker) is NOT a browser spec.
Only `.tsx`/`.jsx` components under a `presentation/` path segment are scanned; coverage is judged per component.
audit: Source name: 'Every presentation component is covered by a SMOKE browser spec'; summary identical.

trace.note: Term id browser_spec used as label for the definition.
